messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High inference tail-latency observed in az1a (route: inference-hosting). Alert threshold exceeded (p99 > 1200ms). Pager: @oncall-sre
maya: seeing spike in 5xx and gRPC stream resets, dashboards show resolver latency up ~3x
eli: confirming, NLB target health checks failing intermittently for a subset of hosts in az1a
maya: rolling a quick query: dig +short @10.0.0.2 example.internal -> high response times
jonathan: can you paste resolver query times?
maya: logs:
```
2026-03-17T14:02:01Z resolver-query 10.0.0.2 latency=240ms
2026-03-17T14:02:15Z resolver-query 10.0.0.2 latency=1200ms
```
oncall-sre: initiated traffic shift to eu-west-1 fallback for critical model variants, enabling canary fallback policy
eli: started NLB target re-registration, but ASG shows some instances in unhealthy state (ENI detach rate high)
maya: KV cache miss rate spiking -> token costs up, and cold-start latency -> customers see increased latency
support-bot: customer-impact assessment: ~4% requests elevated latency, top affected customers: acme-inc, beta-app
ops-lead: open runbook step1: set routing policy to regional-failover; step2: scale up ephemeral in other AZs; doing step1 now
maya: command run:
```
redwood route update --policy regional-failover --region az1a --target eu-west-1
```
eli: applied, traffic shift started (observability: slow decline of p99 on az1a, some green)
oncall-sre: handing off to jonathan for extended mitigation and RCA. @jonathan you are primary, @eli support
jonathan: taking over. plan: keep fallback, triage resolver endpoints, check VPC resolver configs + IMDS + dhcp options
maya: note: customers on Dedicated capacity might still hit degraded instances; raising priority for dedicated pools
jonathan: running healthcheck script on a sample host:
```
curl -sv http://10.1.2.3:8080/health
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```
jonathan: some hosts pass, others fail with ECONNRESET; looks like kernel tx-sched delay or ENI grief
eli: grabbing instance-level metrics and asking cloud provider for ENI attach logs
support-bot: notified affected customers list + templated message drafted, awaiting approval
ops-lead: recommend engaging cloud support if ENI detach rate > 0.5% over 5m — raising ticket
jonathan: adding note to thread: preserving logs at s3://redwood-incidents/3032104567/
oncall-sre: ending active pager rotation; monitor for 30m and escalate if regression
maya: thanks — will keep watch and update thread if anything changes :thumbsup:
